author: Andrew Pistone
title: Top 50 prospect Alex Constanza spurns Georgetown for mid-major program - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrew Pistone ,
12 hours ago Westminster Academy Lions guard Alex Constanza (23) is fouled by Mariner Tritons guard Marcus Kelley Jr. (13) while driving to the basket during the second quarter of a game during 50th annual City of Palms Classic at Suncoast Credit Union Arena in Fort Myers on Monday, Dec. 18, 2023. By Jonah Hinebaugh/Naples Daily News/USA Today Network-Florida, Jonah Hinebaugh/Naples Daily News/USA Today Network-Florida / USA TODAY NETWORK Most of the top 50 recruits in the 2026 college hoops class were already committed at this stage of the game, but Alex Constanza's decision remained one of the largest dominoes yet to fall in the early summer.
Constanza backed out of his commitment to Georgetown in April, which opened the door for major programs like Illinois, Florida and Alabama to sweeten their initial offers.
Instead, Pepperdine emerged and secured the tantalizing 6-foot-8 forward in a major development for the Waves.
Constanza figures to be an interesting player to keep an eye on, both from a college basketball impact standpoint and a professional prospect angle.
The South Florida native attended SPIRE Academy and was the No. 2-ranked player in the state of Ohio.
